newsitem.title: USA: Dynatech shares rise, knows of no reason.
newsitem.headline: Dynatech shares rise, knows of no reason.

text.p: Dynatech Corp said it knew of no reason for the sharp fall in its share price, a spokesman for the company said.
Shares of the Burlington, Mass.-based high technology company fell 5-3/4 to 41 in heavy trade on Nasdaq.
"We honestly really have no clue as to why the stock would do this," spokesman Steve Cantor said. "From our vantage point, the fundamentals of the company are strong."
Jonathan Stone, an analyst with Adams Harkness & Hill, said momentum buyers may be taking profits after its strong run-up over the past year.
"The stock had a big run and perhaps got ahead of itself," Stone said. "As far as I can tell, there's not been any catalyst for the sell-off."
Stone said some shareholders may be worried Dynatech may make some acquisitions that could dilute earnings.

"If that's the case, then those concerns are probably misplaced," Cantor said. Dynatech is looking at making some strategic acquisitions using cash or debt, but they would be accretive to earnings, he said.
